description: Cumulative prefixes of two streamed messages (chunk field stream: a starts with English, b starts with a list marker). The direction is recomputed at every step and can flip as text grows. The third step is a list marker only: no strong character yet, so expected_dir is none and the adapter emits auto.

blocks.note: First strong is still Latin; Arabic later does not flip the block.
Empty list item: no strong character yet, so no direction assertion. The match is empty because the item has no text.
The block flips from none to rtl once Arabic arrives.
